clinical_reports.title: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) Monitoring - Baseline
clinical_reports.findings: Significant hyperglycemia consistent with suboptimally managed Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
clinical_reports.impression: Poorly controlled T2DM. Metformin initiated and titrated.

attachment.ocrRawText: MKCG MCH BERHAMPUR - HbA1c: 8.9% (HIGH), eAG: 208 mg/dL. Baseline diabetic evaluation.

clinical_reports.title: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) Follow-up
clinical_reports.findings: Fasting blood sugar remains elevated but improving on dual-dose Metformin 500mg.
clinical_reports.impression: Improving glycemic control. Continue lifestyle and adherence reinforcement.

attachment.ocrRawText: UPHC WHITEFIELD - HbA1c: 8.1% (H), FBS: 158 mg/dL. Titrate diet.

clinical_reports.title: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) Routine Panel
clinical_reports.findings: HbA1c demonstrated marked reduction from 8.9% to 7.4% across 9 months.
clinical_reports.impression: Demonstrable therapeutic response to adherence tracking. Approaching clinical target (<7.0%).

attachment.ocrRawText: MANIPAL HOSPITALS - HbA1c: 7.4%, PPBS: 142 mg/dL. Excellent response.

clinical_reports.title: Prothrombin Time & INR Monitoring
clinical_reports.findings: International Normalized Ratio (INR) is within target therapeutic window (2.0 - 3.0).
clinical_reports.impression: Therapeutic Warfarin 5mg maintenance for DVT prophylaxis.

attachment.ocrRawText: INR: 2.1 (Therapeutic 2.0-3.0), PT: 23.4s.

clinical_reports.title: Urgent Coagulation Profile (INR)
clinical_reports.findings: Elevated INR above target range. Moderate bleeding diathesis risk.
clinical_reports.impression: Supra-therapeutic anticoagulation. Warfarin dose titrating protocol engaged; avoid all NSAIDs and Aspirin.

attachment.ocrRawText: CRITICAL LAB ALERT - INR: 3.4 (HIGH), PT: 38.2s. Hold 1 dose Warfarin.

clinical_reports.title: Follow-up Coagulation Profile
clinical_reports.findings: INR returned cleanly to mid-therapeutic target range (2.6).
clinical_reports.impression: Stable anticoagulation restored on 5mg alternating schedule.

attachment.ocrRawText: INR: 2.6 (Target 2.0-3.0), stable response.

clinical_reports.title: Digital Chest Radiograph (PA View) - Occupational Screening
clinical_reports.findings: Bilateral upper-zone profusion of small rounded nodular opacities (ILO category 1/1 q/t) with hilar prominence and eggshell calcification noted in bilateral hilar lymph nodes. Costophrenic angles sharp. No acute consolidation or cavitation.
clinical_reports.impression: Radiological findings consistent with early chronic occupational silicosis. High-Resolution Computed Tomography (HRCT) of thorax recommended.

attachment.ocrRawText: CHEST X-RAY PA VIEW: Upper zone nodular opacities ILO 1/1 q/t. Hilar prominence. Consistent with early silicosis. Advise HRCT.

clinical_reports.title: Computerized Pulmonary Function Test (Spirometry)
clinical_reports.findings: Post-bronchodilator spirometry demonstrates a reduced FEV1 (68% predicted) and reduced FEV1/FVC ratio (0.63), indicating an obstructive ventilatory defect with mild restriction.
clinical_reports.impression: Moderate occupational obstructive airway disease superimposed on silica dust exposure.

attachment.ocrRawText: SPIROMETRY: FEV1 2.15L (68%), FVC 3.40L (85%), FEV1/FVC 0.63 (L). Moderate obstructive defect.

clinical_reports.title: Complete Serum Lipid Profile
clinical_reports.findings: Mixed dyslipidemia with elevated LDL and low cardioprotective HDL.

attachment.ocrRawText: LIPID PROFILE: Cholesterol 218, Triglycerides 195, HDL 38, LDL 141. Mixed dyslipidemia.

clinical_reports.title: Inpatient Discharge Summary - Deep Vein Thrombosis
clinical_reports.findings: 48-year-old male construction worker presented with sudden onset right calf erythema and swelling. Lower extremity compression Doppler revealed non-compressible right common femoral and popliteal veins.
clinical_reports.impression: Acute lower extremity DVT. Managed with LMWH bridge to oral Warfarin 5mg. Target INR 2.0 - 3.0 maintained.

attachment.ocrRawText: DISCHARGE SUMMARY - DVT Right Lower Limb. Started Tab Warfarin 5mg OD. Caution: Bleeding precautions.

clinical_reports.title: Scanned Historical PHC Prescription Slip (Odisha)
clinical_reports.findings: Historical hand-written prescription containing Glycomet 500mg, Warfarin 5mg, and an old prescription of Cap Amoxyclav 625mg.
clinical_reports.impression: Historical record digitized via Document AI. Confirms Penicillin and Augmentin allergy flag.

attachment.ocrRawText: CHHATRAPUR SDH OPD - Tab Metformin 500mg (1-0-1), Tab Warfarin 5mg (0-0-1), Cap Amoxyclav 625mg (DISCONTINUED DUE TO RASH).

drug_interactions.mechanism: Synergistic inhibition of coagulation factors (Warfarin) and platelet aggregation (Aspirin).
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Combining Warfarin with Aspirin substantially magnifies the risk of major gastrointestinal and intracranial hemorrhage. Avoid concurrent administration unless strictly indicated under specialist supervision.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: High bleeding diathesis hazard. If antiplatelet therapy is essential, co-prescribe a PPI and monitor INR weekly.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Baseline and weekly PT/INR, complete blood count, and clinical check for occult bleeding.

drug_interactions.mechanism: NSAID inhibition of COX-1 impairs platelet function and induces gastrointestinal mucosal erosion while Warfarin inhibits clotting cascade.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Diclofenac dramatically increases gastrointestinal bleeding risks in patients anticoagulated with Warfarin. Concomitant use is contraindicated.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Severe GI ulceration and systemic bleeding risk. Diclofenac also displaces Warfarin from albumin.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Immediate cessation of NSAID. Check INR and stool occult blood if taken.

drug_interactions.mechanism: COX-dependent platelet inhibition combined with vitamin K antagonism.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Ibuprofen irritates the stomach lining and impairs clotting, creating an acute hemorrhage danger with Warfarin.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Absolute contraindication in outpatient setting.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Evaluate for epistaxis, hematuria, or melena.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Cross-reactive beta-lactam core ring structure induces IgE-mediated type-1 hypersensitivity.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Amoxicillin shares the core beta-lactam ring with Penicillin and can trigger severe anaphylaxis, urticaria, or bronchospasm.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Confirmed Penicillin allergy precludes all aminopenicillins.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Emergency airway and epinephrine preparedness if accidental exposure occurs.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Beta-lactam antigenicity from amoxicillin component in co-formulation.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Augmentin contains Amoxicillin and is strictly blocked for any patient with a verified Penicillin allergy.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Severe risk of immediate hypersensitivity and respiratory collapse.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Continuous telemetry if administered in ICU.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Beta-lactam anaphylactic cross-reactivity.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Ampicillin is a penicillin derivative that will elicit an allergic reaction in penicillin-sensitized patients.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Block prescription.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Skin testing or in vitro specific IgE prior to desensitization.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Arylamine sulfonamide hypersensitivity mediated by reactive hydroxylamine metabolites.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Sulfamethoxazole can induce severe cutaneous adverse reactions including Stevens-Johnson syndrome in sulfa-allergic patients.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: High risk of toxic epidermal necrolysis and DRESS syndrome.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Inspect skin for erythematous macules or mucosal involvement.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Sulfonamide antimicrobial cross-reactivity.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Co-trimoxazole contains sulfamethoxazole and must never be prescribed to patients with documented sulfa allergy.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Prevent cutaneous and systemic allergic response.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Inhibition of COX-1 shunts arachidonic acid to lipoxygenase pathway, causing massive leukotriene release.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Aspirin can precipitate life-threatening bronchospasm in patients with NSAID-sensitive asthma (Samter's Triad).
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Risk of severe refractory asthma exacerbation within 1-2 hours.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Peak expiratory flow, oxygen saturation, nebulized bronchodilator readiness.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Cysteinyl leukotriene overproduction from non-selective COX blockade.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Ibuprofen triggers acute bronchospasm and facial angioedema in NSAID-intolerant asthmatic patients.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Absolute contraindication in patients with AERD.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Dual blockade of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS).
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Combining an ACE-inhibitor with an ARB provides no additive cardiovascular benefit while significantly increasing risks of hyperkalemia, syncope, and acute kidney injury.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: ONTARGET trial demonstrated increased renal adverse events without clinical benefit.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Serum potassium, serum creatinine, and supine/standing blood pressure.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Redundant RAAS antagonism.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Simultaneous use of Lisinopril and Losartan elevates potassium to dangerous levels and impairs renal glomerular perfusion.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Discontinue one agent.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Additive potassium retention through aldosterone inhibition and mineralocorticoid receptor blockade.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Ramipril combined with Spironolactone poses a severe risk of lethal hyperkalemia unless closely monitored in heart failure protocols.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Potassium must be monitored at days 3, 7, and monthly.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Serum potassium, ECG for peaked T-waves, PR prolongation.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Omeprazole competitively inhibits hepatic CYP2C19, decreasing bioactivation of Clopidogrel.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Omeprazole reduces the antiplatelet effectiveness of Clopidogrel, increasing thrombotic event risk in cardiac patients.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Switch proton-pump inhibitor to Pantoprazole, which exhibits minimal CYP2C19 inhibition.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Platelet function assay or clinical monitoring for recurrent ischemic symptoms.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Dual competitive inhibition of HMG-CoA reductase.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Prescribing two statins simultaneously greatly elevates the risk of severe myopathy and rhabdomyolysis without extra therapeutic gain.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Single high-intensity statin titration preferred.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Serum creatine kinase (CK) and liver transaminases.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Additive non-selective COX-1/COX-2 inhibition.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Taking two NSAIDs at once doubles gastrointestinal ulceration and nephrotoxicity risks with zero additional pain relief.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Discontinue duplicate NSAID immediately.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Profound suppression of renal prostacyclin synthesis.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Co-administration leads to acute renal insufficiency and major peptic ulcer bleeding.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Contraindicated combination.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Unintentional cumulative acetaminophen dosing exceeding the 4g daily hepatotoxic threshold.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Combiflam already contains Paracetamol. Adding standalone Paracetamol risks toxic liver injury.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Calculate cumulative 24h paracetamol dose.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Liver function tests (ALT/AST), serum acetaminophen level if overdose suspected.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Excessive cyclic GMP accumulation producing profound systemic vasodilation.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Taking Sildenafil with Nitrates causes precipitate, life-threatening hypotension and coronary hypoperfusion.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Absolute contraindication within 24-48 hours.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Synergistic cGMP-mediated vascular smooth muscle relaxation.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Refractory cardiovascular collapse and syncope can occur.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Contraindicated combination.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Combined inhibition of serotonin reuptake plus CYP2D6 inhibition.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Combining Tramadol with an SSRI significantly raises the danger of Serotonin Syndrome and lowers seizure threshold.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Evaluate for hyperreflexia, clonus, and autonomic instability.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Additive central serotonergic activity.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Risk of toxic Serotonin Syndrome and convulsions.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Avoid co-administration.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Contrast-induced acute kidney injury leads to Metformin accumulation and fatal lactic acidosis.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Metformin must be temporarily withheld prior to and for 48 hours after intravascular iodinated contrast administration.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Withhold Metformin on day of imaging and re-evaluate eGFR before restart.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Serum creatinine, eGFR, venous blood gas / lactate if symptomatic.

drug_interactions.mechanism: CYP1A2 inhibition by Ciprofloxacin reduces Theophylline clearance.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Theophylline toxicity (tachyarrhythmias, intractable seizures) can develop rapidly.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Dose reduction of theophylline by 50% or choose alternative antibiotic.

drug_interactions.mechanism: P-glycoprotein and renal tubular excretion inhibition increases Digoxin level 70-100%.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Severe Digoxin toxicity with bradycardia, heart block, and visual disturbances.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Halve Digoxin dose when initiating Amiodarone.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Serum digoxin trough level and ECG.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inhibition increases statin AUC tenfold.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Acute rhabdomyolysis and myoglobinuric renal failure risk.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Suspend statin during macrolide antibiotic course.
drug_interactions.monitoring: Muscle tenderness, dark urine, CK levels.

drug_interactions.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal tubular secretion of Methotrexate.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Severe bone marrow suppression, leukopenia, and gastrointestinal toxicity.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Avoid NSAIDs in patients receiving high or moderate dose Methotrexate.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Direct additive potassium loading in the presence of reduced renal excretion.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Rapid development of severe, fatal hyperkalemia.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Contraindicated combination.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Potent CYP2C9 inhibition decreases clearance of active S-warfarin.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: INR can spike dramatically within 48-72 hours, precipitating internal bleeding.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Reduce Warfarin dose by 50% empirically and monitor INR closely.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Non-selective MAO inhibition by Linezolid combined with serotonin reuptake blockade.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: High risk of fatal Serotonin Syndrome.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Do not administer Linezolid to patients taking serotonergic antidepressants unless urgent.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Reduced glomerular filtration and sodium depletion increase Lithium reabsorption.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Lithium toxicity with ataxia, tremors, confusion, and renal failure.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Frequent lithium levels required if ACEI started.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Xanthine oxidase inhibition blocks the primary inactivation route of 6-mercaptopurine.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Severe, life-threatening pancytopenia and agranulocytosis.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Reduce Azathioprine dose to 25% of standard dose or avoid.

drug_interactions.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition by Erythromycin reduces Carbamazepine clearance.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Neurotoxicity with diplopia, dizziness, and stupor.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Switch to azithromycin.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Altered hepatic metabolism and lowered seizure threshold.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Fluctuating anticonvulsant levels and increased seizure susceptibility.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Monitor therapeutic drug levels.

drug_interactions.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition by Amlodipine increases Simvastatin exposure.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Increased risk of statin-induced muscle ache and myopathy.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Limit Simvastatin dose to 20mg daily or switch to Atorvastatin/Rosuvastatin.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Synergistic depression of SA and AV nodal conduction and myocardial contractility.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Severe symptomatic bradycardia, complete heart block, and worsening heart failure.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Avoid combination in patients with pre-existing conduction abnormalities.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Paracetamol metabolite NAPQI inhibits vitamin K-dependent carboxylase.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Regular high-dose Paracetamol (>2g/day) potentiates Warfarin and raises INR.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Use lowest effective dose of paracetamol and check INR within 3-5 days.
drug_interactions.monitoring: INR monitoring during sustained paracetamol use.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Inhibition of CYP2C9 and pancreatic K-ATP channel stimulation.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Severe refractory hypoglycemia that may require prolonged dextrose infusion.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Instruct patient on hypoglycemia symptoms and frequent glucose testing.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Insoluble chelation in the acidic stomach decreases Levothyroxine absorption.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Calcium prevents proper thyroid hormone uptake, leading to persistent hypothyroidism.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Separate administration by at least 4 hours.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Ferric ion binds thyroxine to form an unabsorbable complex.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Iron reduces Levothyroxine absorption significantly.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Space intake by at least 4 hours.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Gemfibrozil inhibits statin glucuronidation and OATP1B1 hepatic uptake.
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Major increase in statin plasma levels leading to rhabdomyolysis and acute renal failure.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Fenofibrate is preferred over Gemfibrozil if fibrate therapy is required with a statin.

drug_interactions.mechanism: Shared beta-lactam side chain similarities (1-3% cross-reactivity).
drug_interactions.clinicalExplanation: Potential cross-hypersensitivity in patients with severe first-generation cephalosporin allergy.
drug_interactions.clinicianNote: Exercise caution or skin-test before administration.

recommendedScreenings: High-Resolution Digital Chest X-Ray (ILO Pneumoconiosis Standard)
Dermatological Patch Testing for Potassium Dichromate
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Working with cement and stone exposes lungs to fine silica dust that causes irreversible scarring. Wear an N95 or particulate respirator and use barrier creams on hands.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: NIOSH-approved N95 particulate respirator, heavy-duty nitrile-coated gloves, steel-toe boots, eye protection goggles.

recommendedScreenings: Sputum GeneXpert / AFB smear for Tuberculosis
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Stone crushing produces the highest concentration of toxic quartz dust. Wet dust suppression and P100 respirators are essential to prevent fatal lung stiffening.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: P100 half-face elastomeric respirator, high-attenuation earmuffs (NRR >=28 dB), full-face shield.

hazards: Raw cotton bract and endotoxin dust
recommendedScreenings: Cross-shift Spirometry (pre-shift vs post-shift on first day of work week)
Nerve conduction studies for median nerve compression
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Breathing cotton dust causes chest tightness that is worst on the first working day of the week (Monday Fever). Proper factory exhaust ventilation and masks are vital.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Well-fitting particulate mask, ergonomic wrist splints, regular micro-break stretching.

recommendedScreenings: Serum manganese and urinary chromium levels
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Welding fumes contain vaporized toxic metals that cause sudden flu-like chills (metal fume fever) and lung damage. Always use local exhaust extraction.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Auto-darkening welding helmet (shade 10-12), fume extraction respirator, leather spats and welding gauntlets.

occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Paint thinners and solvents enter the bloodstream through fumes and skin, harming the brain and nervous system. Use organic vapor cartridge masks.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Dual-cartridge organic vapor respirator (OV/P95), chemical-resistant butyl gloves, safety goggles.

recommendedScreenings: Peak flow diary before and after cleaning shift
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Mixing household cleaning chemicals releases harmful chlorine fumes that irritate lungs. Harsh soaps strip protective skin oils.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Heavy-duty flock-lined rubber gloves, cotton under-gloves, kneepads for floor work.

predictedConditions: Lower Limb Chronic Venous Insufficiency (Varicose Veins)
recommendedScreenings: Venous Duplex Ultrasound of lower extremities
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Standing still for 12 hours causes blood to pool in leg veins, leading to painful varicose veins and clots. Walking in place and compression socks relieve pressure.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Graduated medical compression stockings (Class II, 20-30 mmHg), cushioned orthotic insoles, high-visibility vest.

recommendedScreenings: Urine specific gravity and serum electrolytes
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Riding in urban traffic exposes lungs to dangerous diesel fumes for 10 hours daily. Continuous bike vibration causes premature disc wear.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Anti-pollution activated carbon PM2.5 mask, certified DOT/ECE helmet, lumbar support belt, electrolyte water bottle.

occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Auto driving sends continuous mechanical vibrations directly through the spine while breathing roadside exhaust. Ergonomic seat cushions protect the lower back.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: High-density polyurethane vibration-dampening seat cushion, UV-protective sunglasses, earplugs in heavy traffic.

hazards: Cooking oil fumes (acrolein, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons)
predictedConditions: Cooking Oil Fume Induced Bronchial Hyperresponsiveness
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Breathing intense kitchen oil smoke for hours irritates the lungs similarly to passive smoking. Adequate exhaust hoods are mandatory.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Heat-resistant silicone aprons, slip-resistant oil-proof kitchen shoes with arch support, forearm burn guards.

hazards: Toxic sewer gases (hydrogen sulfide, methane, ammonia)
recommendedScreenings: Hepatitis B Surface Antigen & Anti-HBs titer
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Sewer gases can knock out the sense of smell and cause sudden collapse within seconds. Full body waterproof protective gear and vaccination are non-negotiable.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Multi-gas detector badge, heavy waterproof nitrile overalls, puncture-resistant decontamination gloves, full waterproof gumboots.

predictedConditions: Solar Keratosis & Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma
Chronic Interstitial Nephropathy of Agricultural Communities (CINAC)
occupational_risk_matrix.plainLanguageGuidance: Pesticides penetrate wet clothing and skin easily, causing nerve toxicity. Spraying must never occur against the wind and requires complete protective coveralls.
occupational_risk_matrix.preventivePpeAdvice: Chemical spray coverall with hood, wide-brim straw hat, chemical splash goggles, neoprene gloves, knee-high rubber boots.

text.en: I am having severe chest pain and tightness.
text.hi: मेरे सीने में बहुत तेज दर्द और दबाव महसूस हो रहा है।
text.or: ମୋ ଛାତିରେ ବହୁତ କଷ୍ଟ ଏବଂ ଚାପ ହେଉଛି।
text.kn: ನನ್ನ ಎದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೀವ್ರವಾದ ನೋವು ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಗಿತವಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ.

text.en: I get severe skin rash and swelling from Penicillin.
text.hi: पेनिसिलिन लेने से मुझे शरीर पर लाल दाने और सूजन हो जाती है।
text.or: ପେନିସିଲିନ୍ ଖାଇଲେ ମୋ ଦେହରେ ନାଲି ଦାଗ ଏବଂ ଫୁଲା ହୋଇଯାଏ।
text.kn: ಪೆನ್ಸಿಲಿನ್ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡರೆ ನನ್ನ ಮೈಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಂಪು ಗುಳ್ಳೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಊತ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
text.ta: பென்சிலின் எடுத்தால் எனக்கு உடலில் தடிப்புகளும் வீக்கமும் ஏற்படும்.
text.te: పెన్సిలిన్ తీసుకుంటే నా శరీరంపై దద్దుర్లు మరియు వాపు వస్తాయి.

phonetic.en: I get severe skin rash and swelling from Penicillin.
phonetic.hi: Penicillin lene se mujhe shareer par laal daane aur soojan ho jaati hai.
phonetic.or: Penicillin khaile mo dehare naali daaga ebanga phulaa hoiyae.
phonetic.kn: Penicillin tegedukondare nanna maimele kempu gullevalu mattu oota baruttade.
phonetic.ta: Penicillin eduththaal enakku udalil thadippugalum veekkamum erpadum.
phonetic.te: Penicillin teesukunte naa shareerampai daddurlu mariyu vaapu vastaayi.

text.en: Take this tablet twice daily after food with water.
text.hi: यह गोली दिन में दो बार खाने के बाद पानी के साथ लें।
text.or: ଏହି ବଟିକାକୁ ଦିନକୁ ଦୁଇଥର ଖାଇବା ପରେ ପାଣି ସହିତ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
text.kn: ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳನ್ನು ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡು ಬಾರಿ ಊಟದ ನಂತರ ನೀರಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
text.ta: இந்த மாத்திரையை உணவுக்குப் பிறகு தினமும் இரண்டு முறை தண்ணீருடன் சாப்பிடுங்கள்.
text.te: ఈ మాత్రను భోజనం తర్వాత రోజుకు రెండుసార్లు నీటితో తీసుకోండి.

phonetic.en: Take this tablet twice daily after food with water.
phonetic.hi: Yeh goli din mein do baar khaane ke baad paani ke saath lein.
phonetic.or: Ehi batikaku dinaku duithara khaiba pare paani sahita khaantu.
phonetic.kn: Ee maatregalannu dinakke eradu baari ootada nanthara neerinondige tegedukolli.
phonetic.ta: Indha maaththiraiyai unavukkup piragu dhinamum irandu murai thanneerudan saappidungal.
phonetic.te: Ee maatranu bhojanam tarvaatha roojuku rendusarlu neetito teesukondi.

text.en: Do not stop taking this blood thinner without consulting your doctor.
text.hi: अपने डॉक्टर से पूछे बिना यह खून पतला करने वाली दवाई बंद न करें।
text.or: ଡାକ୍ତରଙ୍କ ପରାମର୍ଶ ବିନା ଏହି ରକ୍ତ ପତଳା କରିବା ଔଷଧ ବନ୍ଦ କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
text.kn: ವೈದ್ಯರ ಸಲಹೆಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಈ ರಕ್ತ ತೆಳುವಾಗಿಸುವ ಔಷಧಿಯನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಬೇಡಿ.
text.ta: மருத்துவரின் ஆலோசனையின்றி இந்த ரத்தத்தை நீர்க்கும் மருந்தை நிறுத்த வேண்டாம்.
text.te: వైద్యుల సలహా లేకుండా ఈ రక్తం పలుచబడే మందును ఆపవద్దు.

phonetic.en: Do not stop taking this blood thinner without consulting your doctor.
phonetic.hi: Apne doctor se poochhe bina yeh khoon patla karne wali dawai band na karein.
phonetic.or: Daaktaranka paraamarsha binaa ehi rakta patalaa karibaa aushadha banda karantu naahin.
phonetic.kn: Vaidyara salaheyillade ee rakta teluvaagisuva aushadhiyannu nillisabedi.
phonetic.ta: Maruththuvarin aalosanaiyindri indha raththaththai neerkkum marundhai niruththa vendaam.
phonetic.te: Vaidyula salahaa lekundaa ee raktam paluchabade mandunu aapavaddu.

text.en: I have persistent dry cough and breathing difficulty due to construction cement and dust.
text.hi: सीमेंट और रेत की धूल के कारण मुझे लगातार सूखी खांसी और सांस फूलने की समस्या है।
text.or: ସିମେଣ୍ଟ ଏବଂ ଧୂଳି ଯୋଗୁଁ ମୋତେ କ୍ରମାଗତ ଶୁଖିଲା କାଶ ଏବଂ ନିଶ୍ୱାସ ନେବାରେ କଷ୍ଟ ହେଉଛି।
text.kn: ಸಿಮೆಂಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಧೂಳಿನಿಂದಾಗಿ ನನಗೆ ನಿರಂತರ ಒಣಕೆಮ್ಮು ಮತ್ತು ಉಸಿರಾಟದ ತೊಂದರೆ ಇದೆ.
text.ta: சிமெண்ட் மற்றும் தூசியால் எனக்கு தொடர்ந்து வறட்டு இருமலும் மூச்சுத் திணறலும் உள்ளது.
text.te: సిమెంట్ మరియు ధూళి వల్ల నాకు నిరంతరం పొడి దగ్గు మరియు శ్వాస తీసుకోవడంలో ఇబ్బంది ఉంది.

phonetic.en: I have persistent dry cough and breathing difficulty due to construction cement and dust.
phonetic.hi: Cement aur ret ki dhool ke kaaran mujhe lagataar sookhi khaansi aur saans phoolne ki samasya hai.
phonetic.or: Cement ebanga dhooli jogun mote kramaagata shukhilaa kaasha ebanga niswasa nebare kashta heuchhi.
phonetic.kn: Cement mattu dhoolinindaagi nanage niranthara onakemmu mattu usiraatada thondare ide.
phonetic.ta: Cement matrum dhoosiyaal enakku thodarnthu varattu irumalum moochchuth thinamalum ulladhu.
phonetic.te: Cement mariyu dhooli valla naaku nirantaram podi daggu mariyu shwaasa teesukovadamlo ibbandi undi.

text.en: Please give your 6-digit Consent PIN so the doctor can view your medical records.
text.hi: कृपया अपना 6 अंकों का सहमति पिन बताएं ताकि डॉक्टर आपका मेडिकल रिकॉर्ड देख सकें।
text.or: ଦୟାକରି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ୬-ଅଙ୍କ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ସମ୍ମତି ପିନ୍ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ଡାକ୍ତର ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଚିକିତ୍ସା ରେକର୍ଡ ଦେଖିପାରିବେ।
text.kn: ವೈದ್ಯರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನಿಮ್ಮ 6-ಅಂಕಿಯ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ಪಿನ್ ನೀಡಿ.
text.ta: மருத்துவர் உங்கள் மருத்துவப் பதிவுகளைப் பார்க்க உங்கள் 6-இலக்க ஒப்புதல் பின்னை வழங்கவும்.
text.te: డాక్టర్ మీ మెడికల్ రికార్డులను చూడటానికి దయచేసి మీ 6-అంకెల సమ్మతి పిన్ ఇవ్వండి.

phonetic.en: Please give your 6-digit Consent PIN so the doctor can view your medical records.
phonetic.hi: Kripya apna 6 ankon ka sahamati PIN batayein taaki doctor aapka medical record dekh sakein.
phonetic.or: Dayaakari aapananka 6-anka bishista sammati PIN diyantu jaahaadwaaraa daaktara aapananka chikitsaa record dekhipaaribe.
phonetic.kn: Vaidyaru nimma vaidyakeeya daakhalegalannu nodalu dayavittu nimma 6-ankiya oppige PIN needi.
phonetic.ta: Maruththuvar ungal maruththuvap padhivugalai paarkka ungal 6-ilakka oppudhal PIN-ai vazhangavum.
phonetic.te: Doctor mee medical recordlanu choodataaniki dayachesi mee 6-ankela sammati PIN ivvandi.

text.en: Where does it hurt the most? Point to the exact spot.
text.hi: आपको सबसे ज्यादा दर्द कहाँ हो रहा है? उस जगह पर उंगली रखकर दिखाइए।
text.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ କଷ୍ଟ କେଉଁଠି ହେଉଛି? ସେହି ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ।
text.kn: ನಿಮಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನೋವಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ? ಆ ಜಾಗವನ್ನು ನಿಖರವಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸಿ.
text.ta: உங்களுக்கு எங்கு அதிகமாக வலிக்கிறது? அந்த இடத்தை விரலால் சுட்டிக் காட்டுங்கள்.
text.te: మీకు ఎక్కడ ఎక్కువగా నొప్పిగా ఉంది? ఆ స్థలాన్ని వేలితో చూపించండి.

phonetic.en: Where does it hurt the most? Point to the exact spot.
phonetic.hi: Aapko sabse zyada dard kahan ho raha hai? Us jagah par ungli rakhkar dikhaiye.
phonetic.or: Aapanankara sabuthaaru adhika kashta keunthi heuchhi? Sehi sthaanaku aanguthi dekhaantu.
phonetic.kn: Nimage elli hecchu novaaguttide? Aa jaagavannu nikharaavaagi thorisi.
phonetic.ta: Ungalukku engu adhigaamaaga valikkiradhu? Andha idaththai viralaal suttik kaattungal.
phonetic.te: Meeku ekkada ekkuvagaa noppigaa undi? Aa sthalaanni veelito choopinchandi.

text.en: I feel dizzy and lightheaded when I stand up.
text.hi: खड़े होने पर मुझे चक्कर आते हैं।
text.or: ଛିଡା ହେଲେ ମୋତେ ମୁଣ୍ଡ ବୁଲାଉଛି।
text.kn: ನಿಂತಾಗ ನನಗೆ ತಲೆತಿರುಗಿದಂತೆ ಅನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
text.ta: எழுந்து நிற்கும்போது எனக்கு தலைசுற்றுகிறது.
text.te: నిలబడినప్పుడు నాకు తలతిరుగుతున్నట్లు ఉంది.

phonetic.en: I feel dizzy and lightheaded when I stand up.
phonetic.hi: Phonetic: I feel dizzy and lightheaded when I stand up.

phonetic.kn: Phonetic Kannada: I feel dizzy and lightheaded when I stand up.
phonetic.ta: Phonetic Tamil: I feel dizzy and lightheaded when I stand up.
phonetic.te: Phonetic Telugu: I feel dizzy and lightheaded when I stand up.

text.en: Do you have fever or chills at night?
text.hi: क्या आपको रात में बुखार या कंपकंपी होती है?
text.or: ରାତିରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଜ୍ୱର କିମ୍ବା କମ୍ପ ହେଉଛି କି?
text.kn: ರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮಗೆ ಜ್ವರ ಅಥವಾ ನಡುಕ ಬರುತ್ತದೆಯೇ?
text.ta: இரவில் உங்களுக்கு காய்ச்சல் அல்லது நடுக்கம் ஏற்படுகிறதா?
text.te: రాత్రిపూట మీకు జ్వరం లేదా వణుకు వస్తుందా?

phonetic.en: Do you have fever or chills at night?
phonetic.hi: Phonetic: Do you have fever or chills at night?
phonetic.or: Phonetic Odia: Do you have fever or chills at night?
phonetic.kn: Phonetic Kannada: Do you have fever or chills at night?
phonetic.ta: Phonetic Tamil: Do you have fever or chills at night?
phonetic.te: Phonetic Telugu: Do you have fever or chills at night?

text.en: Have you had blood in your phlegm or cough?
text.hi: क्या आपकी खांसी या बलगम में खून आया है?
text.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ କାଶ କିମ୍ବା କଫରେ ରକ୍ତ ପଡୁଛି କି?
text.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಮ್ಮು ಅಥವಾ ಕಫದಲ್ಲಿ ರಕ್ತ ಬಂದಿದೆಯೇ?
text.ta: உங்கள் இருமல் அல்லது சளியில் ரத்தம் வந்ததா?
text.te: మీ దగ్గు లేదా కఫంలో రక్తం వచ్చిందా?

phonetic.en: Have you had blood in your phlegm or cough?

phonetic.or: Phonetic Odia: Have you had blood in your phlegm or cough?
phonetic.kn: Phonetic Kannada: Have you had blood in your phlegm or cough?
phonetic.ta: Phonetic Tamil: Have you had blood in your phlegm or cough?
phonetic.te: Phonetic Telugu: Have you had blood in your phlegm or cough?

text.en: My legs and ankles are swollen by evening.
text.hi: शाम तक मेरे पैरों और टखनों में सूजन आ जाती है।
text.or: ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ବେଳକୁ ମୋ ଗୋଡ ଏବଂ ଗୋଇଠି ଫୁଲିଯାଉଛି।
text.kn: ಸಂಜೆಯ ಹೊತ್ತಿಗೆ ನನ್ನ ಕಾಲುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಣಕಾಲುಗಳು ಊದಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ.
text.ta: மாலையில் எனது கால்களும் கணுக்கால்களும் வீங்கிவிடுகின்றன.
text.te: సాయంత్రానికి నా కాళ్ళు మరియు చీలమండలు వాచిపోతున్నాయి.

phonetic.en: My legs and ankles are swollen by evening.
phonetic.hi: Phonetic: My legs and ankles are swollen by evening.
phonetic.or: Phonetic Odia: My legs and ankles are swollen by evening.
phonetic.kn: Phonetic Kannada: My legs and ankles are swollen by evening.
phonetic.ta: Phonetic Tamil: My legs and ankles are swollen by evening.
phonetic.te: Phonetic Telugu: My legs and ankles are swollen by evening.

text.en: Take this tablet on an empty stomach 30 minutes before breakfast.
text.hi: यह गोली नाश्ते से आधा घंटा पहले खाली पेट लें।
text.or: ଜଳଖିଆ ଖାଇବାର ଅଧଘଣ୍ଟା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଏହି ବଟିକା ଖାଲି ପେଟରେ ଖାଆନ୍ତୁ।
text.kn: ಉಪಾಹಾರಕ್ಕೆ 30 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳ ಮೊದಲು ಈ ಮಾತ್ರೆಯನ್ನು ಖಾಲಿ ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
text.ta: காலை உணவுக்கு 30 நிமிடங்களுக்கு முன்பு இந்த மாத்திரையை வெறும் வயிற்றில் சாப்பிடுங்கள்.
text.te: అల్పాహారానికి 30 నిమిషాల ముందు ఈ మాత్రను ఖాళీ కడుపుతో తీసుకోండి.

phonetic.te: Phonetic Telugu: Take this tablet on an empty stomach 30 minutes before breakfast.

text.en: How many weeks pregnant are you?
text.hi: आप कितने सप्ताह की गर्भवती हैं?
text.or: ଆପଣ କେତେ ସପ୍ତାହର ଗର୍ଭବତୀ ଅଛନ୍ତି?
text.kn: ನೀವು ಎಷ್ಟು ವಾರಗಳ ಗರ್ಭಿಣಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದೀರಿ?
text.ta: நீங்கள் எத்தனை வார கர்ப்பிணியாக இருக்கிறீர்கள்?
text.te: మీరు ఎన్ని వారాల గర్భిణి?

phonetic.en: How many weeks pregnant are you?
phonetic.hi: Phonetic: How many weeks pregnant are you?
phonetic.or: Phonetic Odia: How many weeks pregnant are you?
phonetic.kn: Phonetic Kannada: How many weeks pregnant are you?
phonetic.ta: Phonetic Tamil: How many weeks pregnant are you?
phonetic.te: Phonetic Telugu: How many weeks pregnant are you?

text.en: Have you taken your tetanus injection during this pregnancy?
text.hi: क्या आपने इस गर्भावस्था में टिटनेस का टीका लगवाया है?
text.or: ଏହି ଗର୍ଭାବସ୍ଥାରେ ଆପଣ ଧନୁଷ୍ଟଙ୍କାର ଇଞ୍ଜେକ୍ସନ ନେଇଛନ୍ତି କି?

reports.findings: Elevated INR above target range. Moderate bleeding diathesis risk.

reports.title: Digital Chest Radiograph (PA View) - Occupational Screening
reports.findings: Bilateral upper-zone profusion of small rounded nodular opacities (ILO category 1/1 q/t) with hilar prominence and eggshell calcification noted in bilateral hilar lymph nodes. Costophrenic angles sharp. No acute consolidation or cavitation.
reports.impression: Radiological findings consistent with early chronic occupational silicosis. High-Resolution Computed Tomography (HRCT) of thorax recommended.

attachment.ocrRawText: CHEST X-RAY PA VIEW: Upper zone nodular opacities ILO 1/1 q/t. Hilar prominence. Consistent with early silicosis. Advise HRCT.

attachment.ocrRawText: SPIROMETRY: FEV1 2.15L (68%), FVC 3.40L (85%), FEV1/FVC 0.63 (L). Moderate obstructive defect.

predictedOccupationalConditions.description: Nodular pulmonary fibrosis caused by chronic inhalation of fine crystalline silica dust during brick cutting and plastering.

predictedOccupationalConditions.condition: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD / Industrial Bronchitis)
predictedOccupationalConditions.description: Progressive airflow obstruction and chronic productive cough from high-density cement particulates.
Deep epidermal fissures, hyperkeratosis, and ulceration from wet alkaline mortar and chromate salts.
Chronic mechanical lower back and knee degeneration from lifting heavy sand/brick sacks.

recommendedScreenings: High-Resolution Digital Chest X-Ray (ILO 2011/2022 Pneumoconiosis Standard)
Spirometry / Pulmonary Function Test (FEV1, FVC, FEV1/FVC ratio)
Dermatological Patch Testing for Potassium Dichromate hypersensitivity
preventiveCareGuidance: Mandatory usage of certified N95 or FFP3 dust respirators (simple cloth masks fail against respirable silica).
Implement wet-cutting and dust suppression methods for all concrete block and tile cutting.
Wear heavy-duty nitrile-coated gloves with inner cotton liners and apply barrier creams before mixing cement.
Strict adherence to ergonomic two-person lifting protocols for loads exceeding 25 kg.
Mandatory 4-liter scheduled daily electrolyte hydration to prevent acute heat exhaustion and kidney strain.

occupational_health_profile.clinicalSummary: HIGH occupational hazard for Construction Masonry with 6 years of exposure. Recommended surveillance: Immediate (Within 1-2 Weeks) with Chest X-Ray & Spirometry.

predictedOccupationalConditions.description: Nodular pulmonary fibrosis caused by chronic inhalation of fine crystalline silica dust during brick cutting and plastering.

predictedOccupationalConditions.condition: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD / Industrial Bronchitis)
predictedOccupationalConditions.description: Progressive airflow obstruction and chronic productive cough from high-density cement particulates.
Deep epidermal fissures, hyperkeratosis, and ulceration from wet alkaline mortar and chromate salts.
Chronic mechanical lower back and knee degeneration from lifting heavy sand/brick sacks.

recommendedScreenings: High-Resolution Digital Chest X-Ray (ILO 2011/2022 Pneumoconiosis Standard)
Spirometry / Pulmonary Function Test (FEV1, FVC, FEV1/FVC ratio)
Dermatological Patch Testing for Potassium Dichromate hypersensitivity
preventiveCareGuidance: Mandatory usage of certified N95 or FFP3 dust respirators (simple cloth masks fail against respirable silica).
Implement wet-cutting and dust suppression methods for all concrete block and tile cutting.
Wear heavy-duty nitrile-coated gloves with inner cotton liners and apply barrier creams before mixing cement.
Strict adherence to ergonomic two-person lifting protocols for loads exceeding 25 kg.
Mandatory 4-liter scheduled daily electrolyte hydration to prevent acute heat exhaustion and kidney strain.

reports.title: Glycated Hemoglobin (HbA1c) Routine Panel
reports.findings: HbA1c demonstrated marked reduction from 8.9% to 7.4% across 9 months.
reports.impression: Demonstrable therapeutic response to adherence tracking. Approaching clinical target (<7.0%).

reports.title: Prothrombin Time & INR Monitoring
reports.findings: International Normalized Ratio (INR) is within target therapeutic window (2.0 - 3.0).
reports.impression: Therapeutic Warfarin 5mg maintenance for DVT prophylaxis.

attachment.ocrRawText: INR: 2.1 (Therapeutic 2.0-3.0), PT: 23.4s.

reports.title: Urgent Coagulation Profile (INR)
reports.findings: Elevated INR above target range. Moderate bleeding diathesis risk.
reports.impression: Supra-therapeutic anticoagulation. Warfarin dose titrating protocol engaged; avoid all NSAIDs and Aspirin.

attachment.ocrRawText: CRITICAL LAB ALERT - INR: 3.4 (HIGH), PT: 38.2s. Hold 1 dose Warfarin.

reports.title: Follow-up Coagulation Profile
reports.findings: INR returned cleanly to mid-therapeutic target range (2.6).
reports.impression: Stable anticoagulation restored on 5mg alternating schedule.

attachment.ocrRawText: INR: 2.6 (Target 2.0-3.0), stable response.

reports.title: Digital Chest Radiograph (PA View) - Occupational Screening
reports.findings: Bilateral upper-zone profusion of small rounded nodular opacities (ILO category 1/1 q/t) with hilar prominence and eggshell calcification noted in bilateral hilar lymph nodes. Costophrenic angles sharp. No acute consolidation or cavitation.
reports.impression: Radiological findings consistent with early chronic occupational silicosis. High-Resolution Computed Tomography (HRCT) of thorax recommended.

attachment.ocrRawText: CHEST X-RAY PA VIEW: Upper zone nodular opacities ILO 1/1 q/t. Hilar prominence. Consistent with early silicosis. Advise HRCT.

reports.findings: Post-bronchodilator spirometry demonstrates a reduced FEV1 (68% predicted) and reduced FEV1/FVC ratio (0.63), indicating an obstructive ventilatory defect with mild restriction.
reports.impression: Moderate occupational obstructive airway disease superimposed on silica dust exposure.
